description: This file defines a sealed internal class 'SharedMemoryPool' within the Orleans.Networking.Shared namespace. It contains a single property 'Pool' which is a MemoryPool<byte> initialized via a static factory method 'KestrelMemoryPool.Create()'. The file facilitates shared memory pooling within the networking component of Orleans.

classes.name: SharedMemoryPool
classes.description: An internal sealed class providing access to a shared memory pool used for efficient byte buffer management in networking operations.

methods.name: Pool
methods.description: A property exposing the underlying MemoryPool<byte> instance used for shared memory allocations.
